blurb: Mid County Lanes offers bowling, arcade games, laser tag, karaoke suites, and party hosting for various occasions including birthdays, corporate events, and school groups. They provide party packages with food, drinks, and game access. Facilities include 32 bowling lanes, Family Fun Galaxy arcade, and private karaoke suites.
